text.p: -- Banco Patrimonio/Salomon Brothers said it is maintaining its buy recommendation on Brazilian state-owned telecoms firm Telemig preferred and its hold rating on its voting common.
-- The bank cited Telemig's better-than-expected nine months results, including a $62.7 million third-quarter net profit and accumulated nine-month net income of $175.0 million.
-- Patrimonio said it projected 1996 net income of $220 million while the market estimated $210 million net for the year.
-- "We could slightly increase our net income estimate as we get more information from the company," the bank said.

-- Preferred B shares of Telemig, a unit of federal-owned Telebras serving Minas Gerais state, was up 1.02 reais at 117.00 reais while its common was off five reais at 118.00 reais at 1420 local/1050 EST on the Sao Paulo stock exchange.
